claims.claim: The six production integrations retain pre-VP03 lifecycle implementation: authoring_ingress, github_issue_ingress and runtime match the exact reference; operator, review_transport and publication differ only for bounded public redaction and private/public record comparisons. Retired issuer, broker, owner and handoff dependencies are absent.

All six designated VP03 modules, six focused test files and six versioned documents are absent. Source, scripts, remaining tests, workflow entrypoints and project configuration contain no references to the retired modules.

Terminal transport applies deterministic projections to RESULT, FAILURE and nested correction records. It preserves canonical identities, source commands, verification bindings and candidate facts while replacing workspace/raw locators and diagnostic summaries, removing diagnostic extensions, and rejecting ambiguous, unsafe or unbounded records.

Runtime completion retains exact TASK/RUN/HEAD binding, clean-candidate and scope gates, Runtime-owned verification/evidence, and canonical RESULT validation. Existing terminal conflict and failure handling remain, without an attestation service or checkpoint authority.

AUTHOR_TASK, SUBMIT_REVIEW, AUTHOR_REPAIR and AUTHOR_REMEDIATION retain the exact pre-VP03 ingress implementation, including canonical identity, expected-state, correction-lineage, reservation and expected-old CAS guards. Git operations use existing credentials without broker routing or privilege fallback.

Publisher retains exact reviewed-source, decision and artifact binding, shared reservation ownership, binding rechecks and expected-main CAS. Publication recovery retains exact admission, source/blob/parent and provenance guards; legitimate replay and conflicting-source rejection paths remain without issuer/broker dependencies or expanded writer authority.

The candidate descends from the original root base and leaves tracked historical artifacts unchanged. Exact pre-VP03 and TASK-334 r2 commits remain readable. Legacy decoding and immutable terminal replay remain supported; the candidate introduces no TASK-333 replay or retrospective TASK-334 record alteration.

The verification implementation, Frozen Kernel specification/freeze and KA-01 prospective amendment match the exact pre-VP03 reference. KA-01 remains NOT_ACTIVATED. Restored integrations add no scheduler, proof-reuse authority or intra-PRIMARY correction capability.

Focused regression cases cover accepted and rejected admission, PRIMARY completion/failure, correction pathways, safe serialization, reviewer ingress, CAS publication and recovery. Assertions cover identity substitution, unsafe records, legacy replay and stale broker configuration. Existing hosted/self-hosted entrypoint definitions are retained.

The committed candidate delta is confined to TASK-336's listed restore, retirement and regression paths. Workflow, roadmap, existing TASK and configuration boundaries remain unchanged. This FINALIZE_CANDIDATE continuation leaves HEAD and the clean tracked tree unchanged.
